name: Brand logo replacement across packaging and cards
intent: Replace the brand logo across three occurrences (pack front, card front, card back) using the approved master with clean alpha and plates, preserving all surrounding areas.

criteria.requirement: The logo comes from the approved master brand asset with canonical geometry, typography, and color.
The black star and the D tail are present, sharp, and correctly positioned relative to each other.
The old logo is fully removed before compositing; no residual lettering, old ink, shadows, or outlines remain.
There is no background patch or halo around the logo; surface texture, lighting, and packaging finish blend seamlessly.
The alpha edge is clean with no matte fringes, color bleed, white border, or haloing along the mark contours.
The logo is not stacked twice, ghosted, or double-printed; exactly one logo instance appears on the pack front.
Preserve the packaging texture, folds, seams, surface shading, and surrounding graphics around the pack front logo occurrence visually.
